notes: Mr. Flesh takes the room. THREE THINGS. (1) THE BRAIN PORTRAIT. His portrait is 'item:jarred_brain', the Preserved Brain item art resolved out of ITEM_CATALOG_CLIENT as a data URI, not a file in the portraits directory. The chamber resolver only understood bare stems, so it built assets/portraits/itemjarred_brain.png and rendered nothing. It now handles all three shapes codec.js:103 does (data:, item:<id>, bare stem) and lazy loads inventory.js once when a post needs the catalog. The art is a 32x32 sprite, so it renders image-rendering:pixelated; upscaling it smoothly turns a brain in a jar into a smear. (2) PINNED TO THE HOUSE. The owner account now renders fleshstation gold and the brain portrait in the chamber regardless of the players row. syncDevAccounts sets faction='fleshstation' on promotion but only runs at boot from a .env that is not present on the VPS, so the row is unreliable and the proprietor was appearing as an unaligned nobody in his own chamber. This is a DISPLAY pin and does not write the row: he must not start collecting a faction colony bonus for it. (3) THE PROPRIETOR VOICE. Mr. Flesh is now selectable in the GM voice picker on the floor, alongside the regent chairs. He is a VOICE AND NOT A CHAIR: seat is null, he cannot table, sign, decline or pull anything, and he does not appear in the seat roster. Giving the house a vote would make every other chair decorative. He owns the building; he does not need a seat at the table. CLIENT + SERVER. Requires a restart. Hard refresh.
